name: Grace Afterall
visual: Female-read tall soft droopy bell ink blob, modest lashes and small faded teal scarf. One hand loosens scarf, other holds single small ivory handkerchief near chest. Half-open white eyes look upward, eyebrows released unevenly, mouth crooked OPEN laughing exhale with two upper teeth and no tongue. Body opens outward in relief while upright. Clearly different from ecstatic joy.
personality: She has just discovered that the worst possibility was not compulsory.
biography: Grace spent the HyperNorm inspection expecting a fault serious enough to explain her worry. The Men in Black found none; Hunky and Dory advised continued readiness. A dissonant card asked whether she could stop preparing for a moment. She laughed before deciding if this was permitted. Now she keeps a handkerchief for tears, dust and the small undignified noise that relief sometimes makes.
note: FrizzleBob: The crisis is over. Her shoulders have received the news.
calls: I can breathe that bit again.
voice: English warm mezzo, a breathy laugh after tension

name: Gilbert Muchobliged
visual: Male-read squat wide round blob with one curled central crest. Both ink hands clasp ONE tiny wooden clothespin to his heart as an unexpectedly precious favour. Huge soft white eyes looking toward camera, inner brows lifted, small CLOSED uneven touched smile. Tiny forward inclination but upright full-size, no kneeling, no human coat. Gratitude, not bashful flirtation.
personality: He receives a small kindness as though it required careful long-term custody.
biography: Gilbert was lent a clothespin on a windy HyperNorm morning and has treated it as evidence that the neighbours are not merely other addresses. The Men in Black prefer evidence of breaches; Hunky and Dory request measurable benefits. A contradictory card asked what gratitude produces. Gilbert cannot supply a figure. He can tell which resident needs their washing brought in before the rain.
note: FrizzleBob: The favour was small. He has made room for its full significance.
calls: I shall remember the useful part.
voice: English gentle rounded baritone, sincere and slightly astonished

name: Alf AlmostaParty
visual: Male-read broad crooked triangular splat with little crooked muted orange paper party cone atop one short crest. Both ink hands suspended mid-clap separated by visible gap, shy shoulders slightly raised. Asymmetrical white eyes wide with nervous delight, one raised brow, OPEN broad lop-sided grin with four widely irregular upper teeth. Eager awkward joy, no confetti or balloon props.
personality: He is delighted to be included and has not yet worked out what to do with his hands.
biography: Alf arrived at the HyperNorm gathering early enough to practise being spontaneous. The Men in Black wanted an orderly occasion; Hunky and Dory supplied an approved level of enjoyment. A dissonant card made the neighbours laugh at something nobody had planned. Alf missed the joke, then joined the laughter. His hands remain uncertain, but he has stopped mistaking uncertainty for exclusion.
note: FrizzleBob: Participation is going well. The clapping is awaiting coordination.
voice: English bright tenor, eagerness interrupted by shy timing

name: Hope Perhaps
visual: Female-read upright reverse-comma ink blob, low swept inkquiff, modest lashes and small dusty rose collar. One hand holds a tiny green sprig close, other palm half opens as if testing an offer without handing anything across cells. White eyes raised toward camera with one cautious narrowed lid and other bright open, mouth CLOSED hesitant upturn with worried other corner. Tentative hope, no fantasy costume.
personality: She is willing to hope, provided hope agrees to speak a little more quietly.
biography: Hope carries a small sprig through HyperNorm rather than announcing that the place might improve. The Men in Black ask what it proves; Hunky and Dory suggest a more impressive plant. A contradictory card says that a possibility need not become a promise. She finds this easier to hold. The sprig now lives where the most tired neighbour pauses on the stairs.
note: FrizzleBob: Improvement is possible. She has not booked the celebration.
calls: Let us see what it does.

name: Cecil Seenit
visual: Male-read chubby pear-shaped blob with three small uneven crest nubs, otherwise bare goo. One hand awkwardly conceals one small unmatched faded blue sock behind his OWN side, other rubs back of crest. White eyes sidelong down, brows lifted at unequal heights, CLOSED crooked compressed mouth trying to whistle but no pink lips. Mortified caught-out posture, still upright and large, no blush overlays.
personality: He would prefer the incident to become a brief and anonymous historical period.
biography: Cecil brought an unmatched sock to the HyperNorm laundry and discovered that everyone had noticed his elaborate explanation. The Men in Black asked for consistency; Hunky and Dory asked him to repeat the amusing part. A dissonant card offered the possibility of a mistake without a verdict. He accepted it eventually. He now leaves the odd socks in a shared basket without assigning blame.
note: FrizzleBob: The matter is behind him. Unfortunately, so is the sock.
calls: I can account for most of this.
We need not give it a name.
voice: English light baritone, dry embarrassment with awkward gaps

name: Morris Makesroom
visual: Male-read broad rounded low-crest goo blob, holding one little folded ochre blanket securely in one hand against body. Other hand makes a low reassuring open palm toward camera without interaction with neighboring cells. Half-open white eyes, raised inner brows, CLOSED small patient crooked smile. Upright with gentle forward attention, not tragic crying, no halo or nurse uniform.
personality: He makes a little room before asking what has gone wrong.
biography: Morris keeps a folded blanket on the HyperNorm landing for residents who insist they are not cold. The Men in Black want names before assistance; Hunky and Dory want a reason worth recording. A dissonant card once left him unsure who was right. He discovered he could offer the blanket before resolving that. This has made several difficult conversations quieter without making them disappear.
note: FrizzleBob: The explanation can wait. There is room beside him.
calls: You need not explain it yet.
voice: English low steady baritone, attentive and unhurried
